item.text: {"search_note":"Search gap: I did not find reliable 2024 reporting showing Erdoğan personally opened his own assets, campaign finance, or close associates to independent audit. The positive evidence is mostly institutional pushback or technocratic/AML-CFT reform, not a clear willingness by Erdoğan to subject himself or his circle to scrutiny.","evidence":[{"title":"Press Release concerning the Decision Annulling Certain Provisions Amending the Law on the Regulation of Internet Broadcasts and the Prevention of Offences Committed through Such Broadcasts","publisher":"Anayasa Mahkemesi (Constitutional Court of Türkiye)","date":"2024-01-10","url":"https://www.anayasa.gov.tr/en/news/constitutionality-review/press-release-concerning-the-decision-annulling-certain-provisions-amending-the-law-on-the-regulation-of-internet-broadcasts-and-the-prevention-of-offences-committed-through-such-broadcasts/","summary":"The court struck down provisions that let an administrative authority order content removal/access blocking and fines before a final criminal judgment. This is real judicial pushback against censorship tools, so it counts as evidence that some independent review still survived.","question_ids":["7B.7","7B.6"]},{"title":"Türkiye: No Transparency on Earthquake Deaths Inquiry","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-12-13","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/12/13/turkiye-no-transparency-earthquake-deaths-inquiry","summary":"HRW says the Interior Ministry tried to suppress disclosure of how many public officials were being investigated for earthquake-building failures, but an Ankara administrative court rejected the ministry’s stay request and cleared disclosure. This is mixed, but it is a genuine pro-transparency counterexample to concealment.","question_ids":["7B.7","7B.6"]},{"title":"Türkiye: Ensure Accountability for Deaths in Earthquake","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-02-02","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/02/02/turkiye-ensure-accountability-deaths-earthquake","summary":"HRW says Turkish prosecutors cannot investigate public officials for duty-related crimes without permission from state authorities, and that the bodies granting permission lack independence from the executive. That is strong evidence of a built-in barrier to independent investigation and accountability.","question_ids":["7B.7","7B.6"]},{"title":"Türkiye: Government Removes Elected Opposition Mayors","publisher":"Human Rights Watch","date":"2024-11-07","url":"https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/11/07/turkiye-government-removes-elected-opposition-mayors","summary":"HRW reports that elected mayors were removed, councils dissolved, and in one case the investigation file was under a secrecy order, with trustees/appointees replacing elected officials. This is one of the clearest 2024 examples of neutralizing local accountability and hiding the basis for state action.","question_ids":["7B.7","7B.6","7B.5"]},{"title":"Turkey | Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism","publisher":"Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism","date":"2024-06-17","url":"https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/turkey","summary":"The report says Erdoğan entered the term with continued tight media control; mainstream and public broadcasters gave disproportionate airtime to incumbents, RTÜK fined critical outlets, and legal amendments increased risk for journalists and ordinary citizens discussing politics online. That is strong evidence against tolerating independent scrutiny.","question_ids":["7B.7","7B.6"]},{"title":"Turkey’s CB governor faces accusations of family influence on bank operations","publisher":"Turkish Minute","date":"2024-01-18","url":"https://www.turkishminute.com/2024/01/18/turkeys-cb-governor-faces-accusation-of-family-influence-on-bank-operations/","summary":"A formal complaint and media reports alleged that the central bank governor’s father influenced staffing, facilities, and personnel decisions, including alleged misuse of bank resources. This is not adjudicated proof, but it is relevant evidence that family influence was plausibly intruding into a sensitive state institution.","question_ids":["7B.7","7B.5"]},{"title":"Turkey blocks access to Instagram platform but gives no reason","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-08-02","url":"https://theprint.in/world/turkey-blocks-access-to-instagram-platform-but-gives-no-reason/2204688/","summary":"Turkey blocked Instagram nationwide without saying why or for how long, which is a direct suppression of a platform that can host reporting, coordination, and scrutiny. This supports the broader pattern of using state power to restrict independent investigation and publication.","question_ids":["7B.7","7B.6"]}]}
